_doc: Corpus patch: Addendum H/I pre-eval route gate. Loaded by determinex_pb_ask_corpus on top of build_knowledge.json so the rule survives without rewriting the giant generated corpus file.

corpus_pre_eval_gate.detect: Any ProgramBench tool before repack, autofix, reimpl fallback, or official eval. Especially source_shape=upstream-source-prohibited, recommended_engine=native-reimpl-loop, reimpl-skill-oracle, spec-local-oracle, or extract-spec-first from determinex_pb_ask_corpus.
corpus_pre_eval_gate.symptom: Watch/autodrive can burn official evals or mutate candidates from corpus advice before Addendum H/I gates are satisfied. Upstream-source tarballs may be re-evaled even though they can never be legitimate solves; near-lock reimpl tails may collapse from direct autofix without local oracle.
corpus_pre_eval_gate.fix: Route through scripts/determinex_pb_corpus_router.py before _repack/_fresh_eval/autofix. If official_eval_allowed=false, stop with needs-native-reimpl, needs-spec-extraction, or needs-local-oracle-tail. Only official-eval after local oracle is green and provenance is few-file source-only.
corpus_pre_eval_gate.proven: Remote bounded validation 2026-06-30: ov -> needs-native-reimpl; csview -> needs-local-oracle-tail; official evals launched=0

corpus_pre_eval_gate_2026_06_30.symptom: Corpus/adjudicator output existed but was advisory, not a hard stoplight before official eval; broad watch could still repack/eval or direct-autofix a tool before native-reimpl/local-oracle gates.
corpus_pre_eval_gate_2026_06_30.root_cause: No reusable route record connected determinex_pb_ask_corpus to autodrive preflight. Corpus prescription did not have an enforceable official_eval_allowed/autofix_allowed/local_oracle_required decision.
corpus_pre_eval_gate_2026_06_30.fix: Added determinex_pb_corpus_router.py and wired determinex_pb_autodrive.drive_one to consult corpus and route before repack/eval. Added global class pattern corpus_pre_eval_gate so every tool sees the rule.

evidence.remote_autodrive_validation: ov needs-native-reimpl; csview needs-local-oracle-tail; newly LOCKED 0; evals launched 0

pb_churn_free_model_ladder_2026_06_30.symptom: The native reimpl loop could be started with a local Ollama model tag containing ':' such as qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct, but the --models parser treated the tag suffix as tier metadata and failed before generation.
pb_churn_free_model_ladder_2026_06_30.root_cause: determinex_pb_reimpl split model ladder entries on every ':' even though Ollama model tags use ':' as part of the model name.
pb_churn_free_model_ladder_2026_06_30.fix: Added parse_model_ladder so only numeric trailing ':tier:cost' fields are metadata. determinex_pb_churn now defaults to a free local ladder: local/deepseek-coder-v2:16b -> local/qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct -> local/qwen2.5-coder:3b -> determinex-coder-base-tiny:latest. The reimpl provider normalizes legacy local/ollama/tiny prefixes before calling raw Ollama and keeps local/deepseek-coder-v2 off the cloud DeepSeek API path.

build_knowledge_trailing_data_salvage_20.symptom: Remote corpus consult crashed with JSONDecodeError: Extra data when loading /root/Determinex/corpus/programbench/build_knowledge.json.
build_knowledge_trailing_data_salvage_20.root_cause: The box copy of build_knowledge.json contains a valid JSON object followed by stray trailing data from a prior corpus sync/append.
build_knowledge_trailing_data_salvage_20.fix: determinex_pb_ask_corpus._loads_knowledge_json now salvages the first valid JSON object and preserves _load_warning so corpus consult continues while the hygiene issue remains visible.
